closure_test: every formula either has no strict-substring relation to another or carries an explicit nesting type, and formula frequency rankings state which policy they apply
identity_surface: the sandhi-collapsed folded form. formulas.py derives formula_id from it and its own maximality rule tests containment on it, so it is the formula's identity. GRAPH_ENRICHMENT_V1's 1,103 reproduces on this surface and only on this surface.
accounting: 2,788 + 918 + 934 + 185 = 4,825. Every formula carries exactly one nesting_type and none is left untyped, which is the closure test's first clause.
reproduces: GRAPH_ENRICHMENT_V1 section M2 (1,103) and FORMULA_FAMILY_RECONSTRUCTION_V3 section 1 (1,593 / 1,103 / 1,119 / 2,037 / 2,788) exactly.
what_is_not_fixed: the nesting type records the relation; it does not decide whether a nested formula should exist. That is a deletion decision and this artifact makes none. Word-order variants are also still unmerged: containment cannot relate daivya hotara to hotara daivya because neither contains the other.
